description: Implementation of CategoryDao interface for database operations related to Category entities, including methods for retrieving categories by various criteria such as name, URL, code, lineage, depth, parent, and store, utilizing QueryDSL and JPA.

classes.name: CategoryDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for Category entity, providing various database query methods.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of categories matching a name pattern within a specific store and language.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Lists categories filtered by SEO URL within a store.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Fetches a single category by its SEO URL within a store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its code within a store.

methods.name: getByCodes
methods.description: Retrieves multiple categories by a list of codes within a store and language.

methods.name: getByIds
methods.description: Retrieves categories by a list of IDs within a store and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Fetches a category by ID and language.

methods.name: getByCode (overload)
methods.description: Retrieves a category by store code and category code.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a category by its ID.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Lists categories by lineage within a store or by merchant store code.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories at a specific depth within a store, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists child categories of a given parent category within a store, filtered by language.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories within a store, optionally filtered by parent category.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories within a store.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Counts products associated with categories within a store.
